correctness.rationale: Homogeneous integral recurrence preserves coprimality; the exact criterion square iff gcd(h,u_n)=1 is Proposition 4.1 of the full primary paper. A projective orbit can reach zero only at its first iterate: p≡3mod4 has no zero preimage, p≡13,17mod20 has preimages ±sqrt(-1) with no predecessors because (-5/p)=-1, and p=2 has sole preimage 1 with no predecessor. Local first-step obstructions have respectively 0,2,1 x0 residue classes modulo p^(a+1). CRT and exact periodicity prove the formula for all h and x0. Actual verifier enumerates all eligible primes <=500 and every residue modulo the predicted period for representative h.

originality.rationale: The motivating primary full text states a per-prime one-time failure bound (Theorem B) and explicitly asks for exact frequencies of zero, one and further failures (Section 7, question (1)). It does not give the depth-one mod-20 obstruction or resulting full periodic density for a family with arbitrarily many split prime factors. Three direct mathematical literature database queries and searches for discriminant -5, congruence classes 13/17 mod 20, and square-failure densities found no equivalent theorem. Accessible prior claims were searched for source 2610.00765, recurrence, and corresponding density without overlap. The separately referenced unpublished companion could still contain an implicit local claim; this residual risk is disclosed.
residual_risks: Unlocated companion preprint on zeros of iterates may contain a general calculation subsuming the depth-one obstruction; accessible bibliographic description does not establish coverage.
